title: Brought-forward LTCL of Rs 80,000 absorbs only the Rs 30,000 LTCG, never the Rs 50,000 STCG; Rs 50,000 LTCL carried on
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.74 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.111 [secondary mapping, not verified]): the net capital-gains loss of a year is carried forward to the following assessment year; (1)(a) a short-term loss 'shall be set off' against any capital gain of that year; (1)(b) a long-term loss only against long-term capital gain; (1)(c) the balance is carried on; (2) not for more than eight assessment years immediately succeeding the assessment year for which it was first computed

Income-tax Act 1961 s.80 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.121 [secondary mapping, not verified]) with s.139(3) and s.139(1): a capital loss is carried forward and set off under s.74 only if it was determined in a return filed within the time allowed by s.139(1)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.111A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: STCG on STT-paid equity 20 % for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % on long-term capital gains 'exceeding one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees' for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024; the gains are those included in total income, i.e. after the s.70 / s.74 set-off
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Manual entry: LTCL 80,000.00 of origin fy 2024, return on time; last_fy 2032.

FY 2025-26 (fy 2026): s.74(1)(b) lets the LTCL absorb LTCG only. It 'shall be set off' against the LTCG of 30,000 even though s.112A would have exempted that gain (same reading as g49) -> bf_set_off_long 30,000.00; LTCG left 0 -> exemption_used 0.00; LTCL left 50,000.00.
The STCG of 50,000 is untouched: tax 50,000 x 0.20 = 10,000.00; cess 400.00; total 10,400.00.
Ledger: origin 2024 long, amount 80,000.00, remaining 50,000.00, last_fy 2032, available.
Alternative (set-off optional against exempt LTCG): bf_set_off_long 0.00, exemption_used 30,000.00, remaining 80,000.00; tax unchanged 10,000.00 / total 10,400.00.
